text: 中国证券投资基金业协会发布2026年9月证券期货经营机构私募资管产品备案月报。 数据显示，截至今年9月底，私募资管产品存续规模合计13.43万亿元（不含社保基金、基本养老金、企业年金），相较于上月底的13.52万亿元减少904.34亿元，环比下降0.67%。
text_en: The Asset Management Association of China released its September 2026 monthly report on the filing of private asset management products by securities and futures operating institutions. Data showed that as of the end of September this year, the outstanding scale of private asset management products totaled 13.43 trillion yuan (excluding social security funds, basic pension funds and enterprise annuities), a decrease of 90.434 billion yuan from 13.52 trillion yuan at the end of the previous month, down 0.67% month on month.
